about: Scorer parity: SYNTHETIC tag index and requests (invented keys, ecosystems and model ids). Every expected value was produced by the offline prototype's own functions (v0.tag_weights, v1.gate_tags, v0.eco_options, v0.tag_eco, v1.UserIndex, p3 P3Index.p3_rank/p3_scores V1, use_u=True; LEX request side) on this index, by a generator that imports non-public code and is not in this repository. Never edit to make a test pass; regenerate. idf is the prototype's unrounded log(usersTotal / users). Postings: [modelId, c, fit | null] (fit only for (resource, tag) pairs with >= 2 users). ranked: the whole ranked list (score desc, model id asc, at most 300) with each S. ecosystems / resolver: the top 3 ecosystems from applying v0.tag_eco three times over the remaining ecosystems (it returns only the argmax), each with its score sum_t w_t ln lift(t, e) over the prototype's lift table; resolver is given for every ranked case, ecosystems only when the request had no baseModel.
